hints.title: Left Prefix Maximum Dominance
hints.text: The left partition must be large enough so that its maximum element does not exceed any element to its right.

hints.title: Running Cut Extension
hints.text: Track the maximum value in the currently accepted left partition as well as the running maximum seen so far.

hints.title: Boundary Shift on Drop
hints.text: Whenever an element is strictly less than the left partition maximum, expand the left partition to include this element and update the left maximum to the running maximum.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def partitionDisjoint(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        max_left = nums[0]
        cur_max = nums[0]
        split = 0
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            cur_max = max(cur_max, nums[i])
            if nums[i] < max_left:
                split = i
                max_left = cur_max
        return split + 1
```
